name: Your agent cannot pay
description: Asked to pay, the agent finds no payment tool; nothing is charged and the cart is untouched.

planSteps.description: Open the home page of this site
Click the 'Your agent' button at the bottom right of the page
Click the task 'Find the Air Jordan 5 in size 9 and add it' and wait for its reply
Click the task 'Pay for the cart' and wait for its reply
Verify 'Tool calls' shows Pay with the result 'Refused: this page offers agents no payment tool.'
Verify the reply reads 'I can't pay. This page gives agents no payment tool; paying stays with you at checkout.'
Verify the header cart button still shows 1
Verify the cart still holds only 'Air Jordan 5 Retro Mens Shoes', size 9, with Total '$225.75', and no order page was opened
